description: This source file provides functions related to file locking, specifically implementing a function os_file_lock that uses fcntl to manage file locks with different lock types (read, write, unlock). It is part of the OSA (Operating System Abstraction) support layer.

methods.name: bool os_file_lock(int fd,enum os_lock_type type)
methods.description: Locks or unlocks a file descriptor based on the specified lock type (read, write, unlock) using fcntl and flock structures.
